text: The curd is scalded and stretched into threads, then plaited. It is pickled in brine rather than ripened dry. Plant coagulants (Solanum dubium, S. torvum) have also been tried for white and mudaffara cheese.

steps.note: The braided type is set at 30–40 °C for about 5 h.
No culture is added; the acidity comes from the milk's own flora.

steps.note: In boiled water, close to the curd's melting point.
